title: A Kind Girl Becomes Queen
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler with the warm, kind heart, and tonight Esther's gentle kindness shines brightest in the palace: Willow walks over to a shy new child on the playground and asks, “Want to play with me?”
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because a kind heart is her superpower. In Willow’s world today: a new child stood alone at the playground, looking shy. Willow could have kept playing, but instead she walked over and said, “Want to play with me?” The new friend beamed. Just like Esther’s kindness shone in the palace, Willow’s kindness helped someone feel welcome and loved.
